standard.summary: 从「从第几轮起加密」那一轮开始，每 N 轮出一次预览。0 表示不启用加密段。默认 0。
standard.effect: 计数从切换轮起算，不是从第 1 轮：切换轮 50、间隔 5 会在 50/55/60 出图，而不是等 62（62 % 5 = 2 那种错法）。校验和定期保存共用同一份节奏，不会各走各的。
standard.whenToUse: 训练后期想更密地看效果、早期又不想浪费渲染时间时。
standard.avoidWhen: 「从第几轮起加密」仍为 0 时填它——切点无效，加密段会被整个关掉。

standard_en.summary: Preview every N epochs starting from the switch epoch. 0 disables the dense phase. Default 0.
standard_en.effect: Counting starts at the switch epoch, not at epoch 1: switch 50 with interval 5 fires at 50/55/60 rather than waiting for 62 (the 62 % 5 = 2 mistake). Validation and periodic saves share the same cadence instead of each keeping its own.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you want denser previews late in a run without wasting renders early.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not fill this while the switch epoch is still 0 -- the switch point is invalid and the dense phase gets disabled entirely.

advanced.principle: preview.preview_cadence 是这个规则的唯一权威：resolve_preview_cadence 读出基础间隔、切换轮、加密间隔与按步间隔，构造不可变 PreviewCadence；due_at_epoch 里加密段用 (epoch - switch) % tail == 0 判定。训练侧三处调用（预览回调与执行循环配置）都走这一份，避免与定期保存分叉。
advanced.intervention: 预览调度判定，与采样器、图像质量无关。
advanced.expectedImpact: 只影响出图频率与渲染开销；对训练本身的数值与速度没有影响。
advanced.tradeoffs: 加密段要求切换轮与间隔同时为正；只填间隔不填切点是这里最常见的「明明填了却没生效」。

advanced_en.principle: preview.preview_cadence is the single authority for this rule: resolve_preview_cadence reads the base interval, switch epoch, dense interval and per-step interval into an immutable PreviewCadence, and due_at_epoch decides the dense phase with (epoch - switch) % tail == 0. All three trainer call sites (preview callbacks and the execution-loop config) use that one object, so previews cannot drift away from periodic saves.
advanced_en.intervention: Preview scheduling only; unrelated to the sampler or image quality.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Affects how often images render and the render cost; no effect on training numerics or speed.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The dense phase needs both a positive switch epoch and a positive interval, so filling the interval alone is the usual cause of "I set it but nothing happened".
